title: Muryar Gaskiya ta Zamanin Dā
intro: Akwai wata rai a cikin Alqur'ani wadda labarinta ya zo a cikin ayoyi kaɗan, amma halayensu masu daraja suna haskakawa da haske mai haske. Wannan tsohon bawan Mai Rahama yana da matsayi a cikin shafukan wahayi. Aikinka shine gano wannan mutum mai ban mamaki. Za ka iya tsammanin su wanene?
clues: Ni annabin Allah ne wanda ya rayu a tsakanin farkon zamanin bil'adama.
Allah ya ambace ni a cikin Littafinsa tare da sauran annabawa, duk an yabe su saboda irin wannan kyawawan halaye.
An siffanta ni a matsayin mutum mai gaskiya a cikin Alqur'ani.
Allah ya ɗaga ni zuwa wani babban matsayi wanda wasu kaɗan ne suka samu.
An ambaci sunana a cikin Suratul Anbiya, an haɗa shi da wasu annabawa biyu da aka yabe su saboda haƙurinsu.
Ni ne Idris, annabi mai gaskiya kuma mai ɗaukaka.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Annabi Idris
Annabi Nuhu
Annabi Ibrahim
Annabi Musa
Annabi Isma'ila

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Kiyaye haƙuri da gaskiya, sannan a ɗaga shi zuwa matsayi mai girma
Gina babban jirgi domin ceton masu imani daga ambaliyar ruwa mai tsanani
A jefa shi cikin wuta mai zafi kuma ya fito ba tare da ya ji rauni ba
Yin gaba da wani babban sarki da kuma kayar da rundunarsa masu sihiri
Rayuwa a cikin cikin babban kifi a cikin zurfin teku
trial.answer: Kiyaye haƙuri da gaskiya, sannan a ɗaga shi zuwa matsayi mai girma

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Matsayi mai girma da ɗaukaka daga Allah
Babban jirgin ruwa da aka gina da alluna kuma aka jefa shi da kwalta
Wuta mai zafi da masu bautar gumaka na mugun sarki ke kunnawa
Babbar teku da ta rabu zuwa busassun hanyoyi
Cikin duhun babban kifi mai kifin teku a ƙasan teku
location.answer: Matsayi mai girma da ɗaukaka daga Allah

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An shigar da shi cikin rahamar Allah a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin salihai
An cece shi tare da dukkan masu bi daga ambaliyar ruwa ta duniya
Ya fita daga harshen wutan da wutar ba ta taɓa shi ba
Ya jagoranci Bani Isra'ila zuwa 'yanci a ketaren teku lafiya
Sun sake haɗuwa da ƙaunatattun iyalansu bayan shekaru masu yawa na wahala
outcome.answer: An shigar da shi cikin rahamar Allah a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin salihai

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
